plan.name: Show a command posted from /act at once
plan.summary: When /act, its Ratify all or the agent's door posts a command that gives its issue what it waits for, as the factory reads it (an answer to every open question, the ratify of its proposal, a retry or a revise), and GitHub takes it, the server keeps the command and at once serves /api/state.json again, to every page, with that issue waiting on no one, queued as D-0093 shows an issue whose person has acted, and `acted` set: `command`, the command lines without the agent's note; `text`, "Ratified. The factory builds it next.", or for a plan of issues "Ratified. The factory opens its first issue next.", "Answered. The factory drafts again next.", "Asked for a new draft. The factory drafts again next." or "Asked for a retry. The factory tries again next."; `url`, the comment GitHub made; and `at`, when GitHub took it. /act then checks commands against the issues as served, so it refuses the same command twice, a post GitHub refuses keeps nothing and leaves its issue exactly as it was, and each refresh forgets every kept command whose comment it has read, found by that URL among its issue's comments, and serves what it read with the rest still applied, so a reload, another tab or another person sees the same until the refresh that reads the comment takes over, and a forgotten command never shows again. In the trusted base, act.go's post and ratifyAll change only to hand each command GitHub took to a new internal/dashboard/acted.go, which keeps the commands and applies them; dashboard.go keeps the snapshot each refresh reads, or loads from the last run, and publishes through acted.go, and issues.go adds `acted` to Issue. On /act the page reads /api/state.json again as soon as GitHub takes a post, and Needs you shows each issue acted on after those that wait, as a card with the command, its text, when it was posted and a link to the comment, offering nothing to post and left out of the count of what needs you; the public page draws Needs you as now, from what waits on a person, so an acted issue just leaves it there. SPEC.md's /act bullet adds that a command GitHub takes shows at once, on every page, until a read of GitHub finds its comment (the README doesn't describe this); since act.go is in the trusted base, a person merges this, and since no decision records it yet, whoever merges it records one that refines D-0093.

tests.name: TestACommandPostedFromActShowsAtOnce
tests.says: With the dashboard's one read of GitHub done and no other to come, a ratify of a plumbing plan posted from /act shows at once in the next /api/state.json, as every page reads it: its issue waits on no one, is queued, and shows the command, "Ratified. The factory builds it next.", the comment's URL and when GitHub took it, while the other issues wait as they did. Answers to every open question, a retry, and a revise through the agent's door, shown without its note, each show with their own words; an answer to one of two questions leaves its issue waiting; and /act refuses the same ratify again.

tests.name: TestAPostGitHubRefusesLeavesTheIssueWaiting
tests.says: A ratify GitHub refuses gets 502, saying GitHub didn't take it, and leaves its issue in /api/state.json exactly as it was. In a Ratify all that GitHub stops at its second issue, the ratify it took shows at once and the one it refused waits as it did, until it's posted again and taken, when it shows "Ratified. The factory opens its first issue next."

tests.name: TestTheRefreshThatReadsTheCommentTakesOver
tests.says: A ratify posted from /act stays shown as acted on through refreshes that don't find its comment on GitHub. The refresh that reads the comment, with the factory's reply, shows the issue as the factory's reading says, building and acted on no more, and the forgotten command never shows again, even when the factory asks for the same ratify again.

tests.name: TestActDrawsWhatWasPosted
tests.says: The page's script reads each issue's acted, and the command it holds, so /act draws what was posted from the snapshot, on a reload or in another tab too.
